schema.name: usefulskills.retained-observations
schema.description: Manually consolidated observations from retained receipts; not a new measurement, benchmark execution, generated validation report, or gate approval.
schema.status_semantics: OBSERVED_PARTIAL describes evidence availability only. PASS in a source receipt remains scoped to that receipt; FAILED describes each nonzero-exit Native evaluation, not a new test result.
schema.missing_value_semantics: NOT_MEASURED or NOT_OBSERVED always has value null and a reason; null never means zero.

units.wall_ns: Nanoseconds retained as decimal strings from the controlled probe.
units.parent_resource_delta: Measuring Node process only: cpu_user_us/cpu_system_us in microseconds; resource_max_rss_kib in KiB; rss_bytes/heap_used_bytes/external_bytes in bytes. These are sample deltas, not child/system totals; negative memory deltas are retained, not clipped.
units.wall_seconds: Whole-evaluation wall duration copied from a Native launch receipt; not model-serving latency.
units.host_display_duration: Coarse host task-completion display, preserved as text; not a monotonic measurement or a quality score.

schema.source_reference_semantics: Repository-relative paths identify retained evidence. JSON pointers select the original fields. External/local paths are retained provenance locations, not newly created files or portable bundled evidence. Parent-supplied host-display evidence is explicitly distinguished from independently read receipts.

scope: Retained observations only; controlled serial Git admission probe, two failed evaluations in the newly unlimited Native window, a coarse host review duration, and separate pure-execution behavior evidence.

immutable_observation_cutoff.scope: Frozen Native evaluation observation subset: retained attempts 1 and 2 and the captured approval receipt, not a live window counter. Later source-only component context is separately cited and does not extend this Native observation cutoff.
immutable_observation_cutoff.update_policy: Do not automatically update this historical artifact after Native attempt 3 or any future evaluation. Future actual observations remain in private proofs so the Native candidate can remain byte-stable.
immutable_observation_cutoff.current_review_authority: .omp/state/tdd/progress.json; cited peer-review states below describe their original receipts, not current live review status.

controlled_probe.status_limit: Original controlled-probe invariants only; not overall AC-020, Native, Goal, legal, or release approval.

execution_behavior_receipt.selector: testResults entry whose name is D:/Projects/UsefulSkills/scripts/execution.test.mjs; assertionResults
execution_behavior_receipt.read_method: Read existing JSON receipt only; no test execution.

execution_behavior_repository_links.availability_limit: T-001 also cites local://ship-t001-green-vitest.json and agent://ExecutionPeer, which were unavailable to this consolidator. The existing bounded-suite JSON above was read directly and contains the 109 passed execution assertions. No unavailable artifact is treated as independently read.

host_duration.source: RetainedMetricsConsolidator assignment: host task-completion notice for ReadUriDiagnosticPeer displayed 9m39s.
host_duration.availability_limit: The associated peer receipt was read, but does not contain duration. The display value is supplied by the parent assignment, not independently recovered from a clock trace or inferred from receipt timestamps.

design.execution_order: serial; one fresh createGitSession per session
design.worktree_scope: known private linked worktree only; no fixture writes or new branch
design.node_startup_child_environment: empty child environment; no inherited secrets exported

capture_hashes.identity_limit: These are hashes retained in the original measurement receipt, not hashes recomputed against the current workspace.

node_startup.parent_scope: measuring Node process only; child CPU/memory not measured

guarded_git.timing_interpretation: Cold minus warm is within-session admission amortization in one version, not a release/version before-after speedup, model latency, or monetary saving.
guarded_git.count_scope: Zero duplicate metadata admissions applies only to these five serial sessions. It is not a token deduplication measurement or proof of external scheduler duplicate-admission avoidance.

retained_security_controls.instrumentation: Retained receipt states the spawn observer delegates to real child_process.spawnSync and returns its result object unchanged; observer metadata is not substituted for native output.

native_unlimited_window.count_scope: Includes ONLY retained attempts 1 and 2 and spent=2 in the captured approval receipt at the immutable observation cutoff. This is not the live unlimited-window counter, the total Native attempts, or the retry/backoff count across Goal47 or earlier windows; future evaluations do not automatically update this artifact.
native_unlimited_window.authorization_limit: Native evaluations for this Goal only; no gate waiver, credential/profile/model global mutation, or premature publication approval.

configuration_not_measurement.interpretation: The 300000 ms setting is an RPC/session operation timeout, not a whole-evaluation deadline. Neither configured value is observed serving duration, throughput, spending, or a measured gain.

attempts.duration_scope: Whole failed evaluation; not model-serving latency or physical serving time. Copied from actual.wall_seconds, not recomputed from timestamps.

failure.message: read used a non-project resource URI

receipt_limits: No inference of actual URI scheme; no claim that prior Root extra-args issue was exercised or resolved.

This receipt used reconstructed original191: two original quality blobs authentic, full191 byte identity not proven because of .npmignore divergence. Later recovery is not retroactively this run's snapshot.

attempts.duration_scope: Whole failed evaluation; not model-serving latency or physical serving time. Copied from actual.wall_seconds, not recomputed from timestamps.
receipt_limits: Operational canonical P1 fixes written; final documentary review pending; not a Native permission waiver or release-gate PASS.

later_source_boundary.receipt_review_state: Independent YieldControlPeer pending in the cited source receipt only; not a statement of current review status. Current review authority is .omp/state/tdd/progress.json; no live counts or later approval are copied here.
later_source_boundary.identity_limit: The yield fix is later source, different from both actual Native launch hashes. Neither failed evaluation proves current-source equivalence or Native success after this fix. No current workspace hash was measured for this report.

aggregate_duration.reason: Per-run wall durations are retained without a sum. They do not establish sequential elapsed wallclock for the window or total Goal47 duration.

host_review_observation.meaning: Actual read/review task elapsed duration displayed by the host, as supplied by the parent; not a review-quality metric, serving latency, or controlled comparative benchmark.

monotonic_duration.reason: No monotonic clock samples or finer precision retained in the provided observation.

associated_peer_result.finding: Read tool aliases bypassed exact-read correlation; existing Source9PASS/RPC13PASS did not cover aliases.

later_scoped_peer_result.scope: URI bounded diagnostic plus two-line alias guard closure only
later_scoped_peer_result.limits: No URI allowance, Native, Goal, or release approval; not approval of later 1308 yield-fix source.

observed_passed_examples: AC-011: pure execution projection, schema and DAG is pure with deeply frozen inputs and returns fresh deterministic views
AC-011: observed resource identity, aliases and capacity reports case alias as a serializable conflict, not structural failure
AC-011: observed resource identity, aliases and capacity rejects unsafe resource capture: duplicate observation
AC-011: exact current returns, history and partial visibility rejects duplicate current return with E_RETURN_SET and leaves independent tasks visible
AC-011: review closure T003-IR-001 running resource occupancy IR001 leaves both idle conflicting tasks individually ready for dispatcher serialization
AC-002: safe execution locks and filesystem roots keeps a conflicting writer blocked when history is RUNNING and its job is absent
AC-002: safe execution locks and filesystem roots keeps a conflicting writer blocked when history is RUNNING and its job is UNKNOWN
separate_execution_behavior_evidence.interpretation: Separate evidence of pure conflict/duplicate-observation/return/admission-decision behavior. It is not measured external parallel execution, physical dispatcher locking, token deduplication, or performance. In particular, individually ready conflicting tasks still require dispatcher serialization.

model_serving_latency.reason: The controlled probe makes no model call; failed Native whole-evaluation durations do not isolate model-serving intervals.

physical_model_serving_or_fallback.reason: No retained serving-provider/backend, routing, or physical fallback telemetry is consolidated here.

model_billing_and_cost.reason: No provider billing ledger or measured cost source was supplied; authorization/configuration and elapsed time cannot establish cost or savings.

model_token_usage.reason: Git output has no model/token data; these Native launch receipts supply no measured token accounting.

token_deduplication.reason: Zero duplicate Git metadata admissions and pure-execution duplicate checks are not provider token/cache deduplication observations.

child_or_systemwide_resources.reason: The controlled probe samples only parent Node CPU/resource deltas; no child Git/PowerShell/Node, model service, or system-wide CPU/memory measurements are retained.

review_quality.reason: A host elapsed-duration display and scoped peer verdicts do not define or measure review quality.

controlled_review_duration.reason: The controlled Git probe executes no review. The separate 9m39s host display is coarse, parent-supplied elapsed time, not a controlled review benchmark.

goal_wide_retry_count_and_backoff.reason: Only spent=2 in the newly unlimited Native window is consolidated; earlier windows are preserved, not counted here. No Goal-wide retry or backoff measurement is inferred.

controlled_probe_retry_or_fallback.reason: No retry mechanism, model serving, or fallback is exercised by the controlled Git probe.

version_before_after_speedup.reason: Cold/warm is admission amortization in one version, not a version comparison.

arbitrary_worktree_effects.reason: Only the known private linked worktree was sampled.

external_scheduler_parallelism.reason: The five-session benchmark is serial. Pure execution assertions do not observe an external scheduler executing parallel tasks.

model_batch_or_throughput_metrics.reason: No model-serving or batch telemetry or throughput workload is present in the consolidated receipts.

limits: The original results.json limits remain applicable to its probe. This artifact adds separately scoped observations; it does not rewrite historical not-measured fields as if the probe had observed Native or review activity.
Historical 19.10s/3.46s observations were uncontrolled and are not reused as a comparison.
Five serial sessions of one exact read-only Git tuple cannot establish external scheduler parallelism, all-workload behavior, or a release before/after performance gain.
Parent resource deltas are not total machine, child-process, or physical model-service resource use; observed zero parent deltas do not turn unmeasured resources into zero.
Native attempts 1 and 2 failed with exit 2; their durations measure whole evaluations only. No model-serving, cost, token, physical serving, or current-source Native success is inferred.
Source hashes identify the particular receipts: d66 for Native1, 7e96 for Native2, and later 1308 for the source-only yield fix. They are not interchangeable.
The host 9m39s observation is coarse displayed elapsed read/review time, not review quality and not invented monotonic precision.
Unlimited evaluation authorization is permission, not observed spending, completed acceptance criteria, or a quality/release gate waiver.
No legal approval, overall Native PASS, Goal PASS, release/publication permission, or task DONE promotion is granted by this artifact.
This artifact is a new candidate file requiring the parent's final inventory inclusion and independent review. It is not claimed to belong to either earlier frozen Native manifest.
